jobs.title: Consultant - 2026/2027 Start Date (Singapore)
jobs.reason: Bridgespan is a social-impact strategy consultancy focused on philanthropy and nonprofit advisory — adjacent to policy but not aligned with the candidate's IR/security/international law focus or the commercial intelligence/OSINT zones they target. The role also requires 3-6 years of professional experience including at least two years in strategy consulting, which the candidate does not have, and proficiency in a Southeast Asian language is advantageous.

jobs.title: Research Administrator: Communications & Events (AD.09)
jobs.reason: The role is a communications/events administrator position rather than a research role, and explicitly restricts applications to South African citizens and permanent residents — a hard ineligibility for this candidate. It also requires an Honours degree in Communications/Marketing/Journalism and specific digital-comms tooling (WordPress, Canva, SEO, social media analytics) outside the candidate's profile.

jobs.title: Associate Director - Dispute Intelligence (Maternity Cover)
jobs.reason: Control Risks and intelligence work are core target areas for the candidate, but "Associate Director" is a senior title that requires substantial professional experience the candidate (MSc in progress, only student-assistant roles) does not have. Hard ineligibility on seniority.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager, Cyber APAC
jobs.reason: This is a cybersecurity sales role focused on revenue targets, cold-calling, and CRM pipeline management — pure commercial sales rather than intelligence or policy analysis. It also requires a minimum of 5 years' experience as a hard requirement, triggering the seniority ineligibility rule.

jobs.title: Senior Insights Manager (Media and Research) (6 Month FTC)
jobs.reason: This is a commercial PR/marketing insights role focused on brand strategy and media measurement for corporate clients, not policy, geopolitical risk, or OSINT work — outside the candidate's target zones. The role also requires expert hands-on experience with specific commercial listening/analytics tools (Brandwatch, Meltwater, Synthesio, Quid, Tableau, etc.) the candidate does not have, and the "Senior Manager" title with client/account management and mentoring responsibilities implies several years of agency experience beyond the candidate's student-assistant background.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Associate
jobs.reason: Hard ineligibility: the role explicitly requires a PhD in data science, infrastructure studies, or a related field, which the candidate (currently MSc) does not hold. The substantive focus on datafied welfare states and platform/AI infrastructures is broadly relevant to the candidate's hybrid tech-policy interests, but the post also demands specialist technical experience analysing data infrastructures and building public-facing databases that exceeds the candidate's current skill set.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
jobs.reason: Hard ineligibility: role explicitly requires 5+ years of B2B digital marketing experience, which the candidate does not have. Field is also a mismatch — commercial B2B marketing for assurance/certification services is unrelated to the candidate's IR/policy focus, and required tooling (Pardot, HubSpot, Salesforce, SEO/SEM platforms) is outside their skill set.

jobs.title: Embedded Intelligence Program Manager
jobs.reason: Field alignment is excellent — Sibylline is a core target and corporate intelligence/geopolitical analysis fits squarely with the candidate's interests. However, the role is a Program Manager position requiring 5–7+ years of experience including 3–5 years of management experience as a hard requirement, which triggers the hard ineligibility rule on seniority for a candidate still completing their MSc.

jobs.title: Researcher (Fluent French or Portuguese): Six month Fixed Term Contract
jobs.reason: Control Risks is a core target firm in commercial intelligence and the researcher role aligns directly with the candidate's interests. However, the role explicitly requires fluency in French or Portuguese — the candidate has only B1 French and no Portuguese, which triggers the hard ineligibility rule on required working language.

jobs.title: Community and Events Fundraising Assistant
jobs.reason: Although MSF is a humanitarian organisation, this is a fundraising/donor stewardship role with no research, policy, or analytical content relevant to the candidate's IR/security focus. The work centres on supporter care, event admin, and database management — transferable but a weak field fit and not aligned with any of the candidate's three target zones.

jobs.title: Policy Counsel, EMEA
jobs.reason: Hard ineligibility: the role requires a law degree and qualification to practice law in an EMEA jurisdiction, which the candidate does not hold, and prefers 6+ years of legal experience. While AI policy is a core field of interest, this is a qualified-lawyer position outside the candidate's reach.

jobs.title: Afghan Investigator Talent Pool
jobs.reason: CIR open-source investigations are a core target zone, but this specific talent pool is for Afghan investigators — almost certainly requiring Dari/Pashto language skills, Afghanistan regional expertise, and likely lived experience, none of which the candidate has. Field is adjacent but the role-specific requirements create a substantive mismatch.

jobs.title: Strategic Litigation Team Manager
jobs.reason: Human rights litigation aligns broadly with the candidate's international law interests, but "Team Manager" at Reprieve's Project/Regional Lead pay band implies significant managerial and legal experience the candidate lacks. Strategic litigation roles typically require a qualifying law degree and several years of experience — hard ineligibility on seniority.
jobs.salary: £52,088 plus up to 5% employee matched pension contribution
